title: ecb-3: add unit tests for ber_len_decode and RSA-2048 PIV response parsing
description: Add tests in wp11_test_piv.c: (1) ber_len_decode short form 0x00, 0x7F, (2) one-byte long form 0x81 0xFF, (3) two-byte long form 0x82 0x01 0x00 = 256, (4) indefinite 0x80 returns error, (5) truncated buffer returns error. Also add a mock CCID test where the PIV sign response uses a 3-byte length (simulating RSA-2048) and verify the signature bytes are extracted correctly. Vectors: RSA-2048 sig response 7C 82 01 04 82 82 01 00 [256 bytes sig].
